title: Intent Validator Output
description: Output contract for the `intent-validator` agent. Validates that completed work matches the user's original intent.

original_intent.description: 1-2 sentence summary of what the user wanted (from docs/context/intent.md).

what_was_built.description: 1-2 sentence summary of what was actually implemented.

scope_gaps.description: What was requested but not built. Empty array if fully covered.

interpretation_drift.description: Where implementation diverged from the user's likely mental model. Empty if aligned.

assumption_gaps.description: Assumptions made that the user hasn't confirmed.

ux_gaps.description: Ways the implementation might surprise or confuse the user.

completeness.description: Would the user consider this 'done'? What would they immediately ask about next?

user_confirmation.description: Questions asked of the user and their answers. Empty arrays if no questions were needed.

answer.description: The user's response, recorded verbatim or summarized faithfully.

recommended_actions.description: If verdict is needs-work: specific tasks to close gaps. If needs-discussion: what to clarify. If satisfied: empty array.
